    Bug 1957494 - Remove the experimental label for dark message reader feature. r=darktrojan

diff --git a/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml b/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
index 27875dd60f0..50a9a28e47f 100644
--- a/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
+++ b/mail/components/preferences/general.inc.xhtml
@@ -805,13 +805,12 @@
       <vbox>
         <hbox class="align-baseline">
           <html:legend data-l10n-id="dark-message-mode-legend"></html:legend>
-          <html:span class="label-experiment" data-l10n-id="label-experiment"></html:span>
         </hbox>
         <vbox>
           <checkbox id="darkReader"
                     data-l10n-id="dark-message-mode-checkbox-label"
                     preference="mail.dark-reader.enabled"/>
-          <description data-l10n-id="dark-message-mode-checkbox-description"
+          <description data-l10n-id="dark-message-mode-description"
                        class="tip-caption indent"/>
           <checkbox id="darkReaderToggle"
                     data-l10n-id="dark-message-mode-toggle-label"
diff --git a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
index a171633ca19..8db7ccbe36b 100644
--- a/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
+++ b/mail/locales/en-US/messenger/preferences/preferences.ftl
@@ -566,7 +566,7 @@ dark-message-mode-legend = Message reader style
 dark-message-mode-checkbox-label =
     .label = Enable dark message mode
     .accesskey = d
-dark-message-mode-checkbox-description = Experimental feature to make the message body follow dark themes
+dark-message-mode-description = Force the message body to follow dark themes
 
 dark-message-mode-toggle-label =
     .label = Show dark message mode toggle
